claimLevel: DEVICE_MEASURED (placement: each point was pressed on the handset and the next native SNAP showed the named effect); timings are not claimed here

view.mapping: Display Mode FULL stretches the 1024x768 window to 2400x1080: screen_x = (frame_x - scroll) * 2.34375, screen_y = frame_y * 1.40625. The room view is centred on `follow` X, clamped to 512..788 (g25), so scroll is 0 looking left, 238 at the hub (follow 750, g681-g703) and 276 looking right.
view.pan: A touch held at game screen x < 205 pans left 12 px/frame, < 345 left 6; > 819 right 12, > 679 right 6 (g21-g24). Touches in 345..679 do not pan -- which is why a double tap meant for the closet at native x 1640 from the left view panned the room instead (f4-views 0024).
view.tips: Options -> Show Tips / Instructions cycles NIGHT 1 -> NEVER -> ALWAYS; set to NEVER on 2026-09-25 so Night 1 renders like every later night (the tip boxes sit over the bed, door and closet views).

leftDoor.effect: carpet run to the left door (f4-n1 0005/0006); frame hitzone 32..288 x 268..558 (g723)

rightDoor.effect: carpet run to the right door (f4-views 0041/0042); frame hitzone 1012..1268

closet.effect: to the closet (f4-views 0051/0052); from room-left use x 1340..1590

back.effect: run back / turn around; HUDGoBackHitzone 256..768 x 601..751 (g723) = native 600..1800 x 845..1056

flashlight.effect: lit hall (f4-n1 0020), lit closet (f4-views 0055), lit bed (f4-views 0018); x 632 is inside the go-back strip and ran back instead (f4-n1 0010)
